enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Turn onto back. Pull blanket up. Push blanket down. Turn head. Lie still. Repeat turning.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Read patient list. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check blood pressure. Check temperature. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to next patient. Repeat.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Turn. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select program. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll screen. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for leisure or study
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open browser. Open document. Type. Read. Scroll. Save file. Open email. Reply. Close email. Open video. Watch. Close video. Shut down computer. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off water. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Lie down.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Turn onto back. Pull blanket up. Push blanket down. Turn head. Lie still. Repeat turning.
